name: Mux
description: Mux's hosted server manages video assets, live streams and playback, and reads Mux Data metrics.

probe.note: Answers an unauthenticated initialize with 401 and publishes OAuth metadata; the authorization server (auth.mux.com) offers dynamic client registration, so a harness can sign in without a pre-registered app. The sign-in itself was not completed by this check.
